candidates.change_summary: Replace the owner check to allow anyone (remove require(msg.sender == owner)) so sendTo can be invoked by any caller, changing which transfers occur and thus observed behavior.
Change the zero-address guard to allow address(0) as a receiver, enabling transfers to the zero address which changes observable state (Ether burned to zero address).
Change amount > 0 requirement to allow zero-value transfers (remove require(amount > 0)), so calls with amount == 0 become observable differently.
Replace transfer with a no-op (commented out) to prevent sending Ether while keeping checks, changing post-call balances and observable behavior.
Invert the owner check to require caller NOT be the owner, altering which callers can trigger transfers and thus observable behavior.
